weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

passive.name: Inheritance
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by **28/35/42/49/56%**. When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases CRIT Rate by **15/18.75/22.5/26.25/30%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) > BREAK EFFECT% (If Break Build) >= CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: Fighting Will > Ready for Battle > Perseverance

entries.name: Farewell Hit
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **100%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: RIP Home Run
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **125%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Stardust Ace
entries.text:
Choose between two attack modes to deliver a full strike.
"Blowout: Farewell Hit" deals Physical DMG equal to **450%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.
"Blowout: RIP Home Run" deals Physical DMG equal to **270%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy, and Physical DMG equal to **162%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Blowout: Farewell Hit
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **450%** of the Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Blowout: RIP Home Run
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **270%** of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to **162%** of Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

entries.name: Perfect Pickoff
entries.text: Each time after this character inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, ATK increases by **20%**. This effect stacks up to **2** time(s).

entries.name: Immortal Third Strike
entries.text: Immediately heals all allies for **15%** of their respective Max HP after using this Technique.

entries.name: Ready for Battle
entries.text: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates **15** Energy.

entries.name: Tenacity
entries.text: Each Talent stack increases the Trailblazer's DEF by **10%**.

entries.name: Fighting Will
entries.text: When using Skill or Ultimate "Blowout: RIP Home Run," DMG dealt to the target enemy is increased by **25%**.

entries.name: A Falling Star
entries.text: When enemies are defeated due to the Trailblazer's Ultimate, the Trailblazer regenerates 10 extra Energy. This effect can only be triggered once per attack.

entries.name: An Unwilling Host
entries.text: Attacking enemies with Physical Weakness restores the Trailblazer's HP equal to 5% of the Trailblazer's ATK.

entries.name: A Leading Whisper
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: A Destructing Glance
entries.text: When attacking an enemy that is Weakness Broken, increases CRIT Rate by 25%.

entries.name: A Surviving Hope
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: A Trailblazing Will
entries.text: The Trailblazer's Talent is also triggered when they defeat an enemy.
